system.description:
Once per turn as a Reaction, when an enemy is reduced to 0 Hit Points or is moved down the Condition Track by any means, you allow one ally within your line of sight to take their Second Wind immediately (as a Free Action).

Furthermore, when your ally takes their Second Wind, they regain a number of additional Hit Points equal to your Class Level.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Legacy Era Campaign Guide
